universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use generic centered layouts or plain gradients without depth.
Ensure every interactive element has a valid data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in dropdowns, floating menus, or header navigation.
Provide interactive sample data so judges or viewers can test the end-to-end pipeline in one click.
Make the Demo Mode indicator prominently visible on top right or top banner.
Use Lucide React icons for tools like Jira, Gmail, Calendar, Check, Play, Edit, Trash, AlertCircle, ArrowRight.
Keep typography sharp and technical: monospace font for reasoning traces, timestamps, and confidence scores.
Maintain responsive grid layouts with mobile support (1 column on mobile, 2-3 columns on desktop).
